post.summary: Stage 4 & 5: Reserve Tickets with Anti-Overbooking Lock
post.description:
Stage 4 & 5: Selection & Booking.
- Distributed Lock prevents race conditions across instances.
- Database row-level lock ensures atomic inventory decrement.
- Establishes a temporary reservation hold (default: 10 minutes).

post.summary: Stage 6: Confirm Booking & Generate Digital Tickets
post.description:
Stage 6: Confirmation.
Validates the reservation hold, finalizes the order status to CONFIRMED,
and generates unique digital tickets with gate-scan QR payloads.

post.summary: Send message to AI Ticketing Assistant
post.description:
Core Conversational Endpoint for the 7-Stage Customer Booking Workflow:
1. Discovery: Search events & venues
2. Recommendation: Get curated event suggestions
3. Availability: Check live ticket tiers & pricing
4. Selection: Guide ticket type and quantity
5. Booking: Validate details & atomically lock inventory
6. Confirmation: Record order & issue digital tickets
7. Post-booking: Retrieve tickets & process cancellations
